query: How many hours is one internship credit as per AICTE?
answer: As per AICTE Internship Policy 2019 and UGC Guidelines, 1 internship credit is equivalent to 45 hours (or 30 hours for classroom-based activities). [internship_doc_1.pdf, Page 7]

query: Does an online internship count for AICTE credits?
answer: Yes, online internships are recognized by AICTE Table 2 when conducted with registered firms or government bodies. [internship_doc_1.pdf, Page 9]
